allowed_claim: EET reduced over-entitlement error relative to applicable baselines in both development and confirmatory synthetic benchmarks.
In the confirmatory benchmark, EET V2 achieved OEE 0.068333 and macro-F1 0.892995.
EET V2 improved condition-split F1 relative to the context-stratified baseline in the confirmatory benchmark.
EET's advantage was conditional: severe missingness, low evidence density, and heavy corruption increased under-entitlement.
The framework is positioned as an integration of established mathematical tools around scientific claim entitlement rather than as a new poset, hypergraph, or VOI theory.
Claim order, obligation structure, frontier, and transfer remained the core components after ablation.
